settings.title: AIS Tracker Settings
settings.api_key_description: Create a free API key at aisstream.io
settings.aishub_username_description: Requires an AISHub membership with your own NMEA station feed: API access is granted only while your station reports ≥10 vessels per 7 days with ≥90 % uptime. Poll one username from ONE device only — AISHub allows max 1 request per minute.
settings.ais_source_description: aisstream = today's behavior (default). shadow = AISHub is polled and measured (🔭 SHADOW_COMPARE in the log) without affecting bridge status. both = dual-source fusion (freshest fix wins). aishub = AISHub only.
settings.debug_level_description: Choose debug level for troubleshooting. Higher levels provide more detailed logs but may impact performance.
